params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia driver bug reportedly writes up to 30GB an hour to SSDs Users report that GeForce drivers 621.14 and 621.24 keep rewriting a log file nonstop through a background service, putting gigabytes of writes on SSDs every hour even while the PC sits idle. The newer driver is reportedly still affected, so check your disk activity if you're on either version. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 00:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @NVIDIAGeForce · @nvidia ⚠️ Share with a GeForce friend · 💬 Have you noticed SSD wear? #Nvidia #GeForce #SSD #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
